name: 33909 · Cape Coral, FL
findings: ZIP 33909 (Cape Coral) has 55 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33909 (Cape Coral) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
56% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
